duration.text: The Long-term Chinese Language Courses at Jiangnan University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Color scan copy of passport (photo page) Photographs taken within the past six months (no headwear, frontal vertical format, one-inch ID photo, JPG or JPEG format, not larger than 1MB) Original color scan of the highest academic degree certificate (or notarized Chinese/English copy) Economic guarantee certificate Deposit certificate (bank transaction record within the past 6 months, with the balance in the card being no less than the tuition fee to be paid) Those under the age of 18 must provide a letter of authorization. No criminal record Physical examination report (within the last 6 months)

requirements.text: 1. The applicant must be a non-Chinese citizen, with good conduct and good health; abide by Chinese laws and regulations as well as the school's rules and regulations; respect Chinese customs and traditions, and be pro-China and friendly towards China. 2. Applicant's age: 18 years old and above, under 60 years old. (If the applicant is under 18 years old and the parents are not permanently residing in China, the parents are required to provide an authorization and power of attorney certificate, entrusting a person with guardianship ability who is permanently residing in China to act as the legal guardian of the student, and providing relevant proof materials of the guardian.)
